Plan: identify invoice markers, confirm invoice, locate required fields (GrandTotal.Amount, Invoice.Date, Sender.VatId, Vat.Rate, Net.Amount, Vat.Amount). Verify ambiguous candidates and choose best-supported values; do not guess missing data.

1) Document classification
- Header contains "Rechnung" (German for invoice) and invoice-like sections (Rechnungs-Nr., Rechnungsdatum, Lieferadresse, Artikel, Zwischensumme, MwSt, Rechnungsbetrag). No exclusion terms like "Mahnung" or "Zahlungserinnerung" in prominent positions. Conclusion: this is an invoice — proceed.

2) Locate Invoice.Date
- Found "Rechnungsdatum: 17.03.2023". This is explicit invoice issue date. Candidate: "17.03.2023".

3) Locate Sender.VatId
- Two VAT-like values present:
  a) Near Lieferadresse: "USTID: ATU 22642807" — appears adjacent to the delivery/customer address (Bäckerei Schmidl) → likely customer's VAT.
  b) In footer under Günthart GmbH: "ATU38510009" (labeled near company contact info) → likely the issuer/sender VAT. According to rule "Sender.VatId = Tax ID of the sender (VAT)". Choose "ATU38510009" as Sender.VatId.

4) Locate GrandTotal.Amount
- Multiple amounts:
  - "Zwischensumme EUR 58,45" (subtotal)
  - "Warenwert (10,00 %) 58,45"
  - "MwSt (10,00 %) 5,85"
  - Two lines showing "Rechnungsbetrag": one "Rechnungsbetrag EUR 62,37" appears next to "Skontobetrag EUR 1,93" and another "Rechnungsbetrag EUR 64,30".
- Interpretations:
  - 62,37 appears to be the invoice total after applying a 3% cash discount (Skonto) or maybe the net after discount — the layout shows "Bei Zahlung bis 31.03.2023 gewähren wir 3,00 % Skonto." followed by numbers and "Skontobetrag EUR 1,93" and "Rechnungsbetrag EUR 62,37" — that suggests 62,37 is the amount after discount (payable if paid early).
  - 64,30 is labeled "Rechnungsbetrag EUR 64,30" on another line and likely the gross invoice amount due without taking Skonto into account (total payable per invoice).
- Requirement: "GrandTotal.Amount: Total payable amount on the invoice" — interpret as the billed total on the invoice document. The clear labeled full invoice total is "Rechnungsbetrag EUR 64,30". Choose 64.30 as GrandTotal.Amount (numeric).

5) Locate Vat.Rate, Net.Amount, Vat.Amount
- VAT group shown: "MwSt (10,00 %) 5,85" and "Warenwert (10,00 %) 58,45".
- Vat.Rate: 10,00 % → per rule extract without percent as number; preserve decimals present. Input uses comma, so numeric value = 10.00.
- Net.Amount: Warenwert 58,45 → numeric 58.45.
- Vat.Amount: 5,85 → numeric 5.85.

6) Consistency check
- Net 58.45 + VAT 5.85 = 64.30 matches chosen GrandTotal.Amount 64.30. The alternative total 62.37 corresponds to applying 3% Skonto (62.37 + Skonto 1.93 = 64.30), so interpretation is consistent.

Conclusion: all required fields present and chosen values are supported by invoice text. Final extraction will use:
- GrandTotal.Amount: 64.30
- Invoice.Date: "17.03.2023"
- Sender.VatId: "ATU38510009"
- Vat.Rate: 10.00
- Net.Amount: 58.45
- Vat.Amount: 5.85
